scenes.text: Every scam starts the same way. Someone is in a hurry. And it isn't you.
Last year, Americans reported twenty point nine billion dollars lost to online scams. The money was sent by the real owner, from their real phone. So nothing looked wrong.
Pause AI takes the urgency away.
Pay someone you trust, and it goes straight through. Anything risky waits in your own vault, with a countdown, and a cancel button.
While it waits, Pause asks the questions scammers coach people to lie about. A private AI reads the answers inside a sealed enclave, and shows you the proof.
And the people who love you get a say. One tap from your son or daughter stops the payment. The money never leaves.
You don't need to read a risk score. Just talk. Pause answers out loud, in your language.
Cela ressemble à une arnaque. Votre banque ne vous demandera jamais de déplacer votre argent vers un compte sécurisé.
Esto parece una estafa. Llame usted mismo a su hijo, al número de siempre, antes de enviar dinero.
Bu bir dolandırıcılığa benziyor. Bağlantıya dokunmayın. Kargo şirketinin kendi uygulamasını açın.
这看起来像是诈骗。没有人能保证收益。请先和家人商量。
Even a payment you never made. One bad link, a thief signs with your key, and it still waits in the vault, until your family says yes.
Built on NEAR. A Rust contract holds the money. The AI's key can do two things, and neither of them is move it.
Pause AI. See a scam stopped, in two minutes.
